title: An editor opened before an erase and saved after it is refused with connection words; give the refusal its own outcome
evidence: Found 2026-11-25 in PR 2081's review: RoadmapStore.correctValue (widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store.ts) answers 'error' for an erase refusal, so the editor says the connection words. Answering 'changed' instead was tried and taken out: refuses() is also true while this tab is mid-erase, so it closed the editor with false words and lost the edit if that erase failed, and it changed two other callers (body-measures.ts, useWidgetSave.ts) with no test.
